entries.prompt_text: Open the mouth with mild intensity. Preserve identity, face shape, skin tone, hair, clothing, background and illumination as far as the model allows.
Open the mouth with moderate intensity. Preserve identity, face shape, skin tone, hair, clothing, background and illumination as far as the model allows.
Open the mouth with strong intensity. Preserve identity, face shape, skin tone, hair, clothing, background and illumination as far as the model allows.
Turn the face toward the left side of the image with mild intensity. Preserve identity, face shape, skin tone, hair, clothing, background and illumination as far as the model allows.
Turn the face toward the left side of the image with moderate intensity. Preserve identity, face shape, skin tone, hair, clothing, background and illumination as far as the model allows.
Turn the face toward the left side of the image with strong intensity. Preserve identity, face shape, skin tone, hair, clothing, background and illumination as far as the model allows.
Turn the face toward the right side of the image with mild intensity. Preserve identity, face shape, skin tone, hair, clothing, background and illumination as far as the model allows.
Turn the face toward the right side of the image with moderate intensity. Preserve identity, face shape, skin tone, hair, clothing, background and illumination as far as the model allows.
Turn the face toward the right side of the image with strong intensity. Preserve identity, face shape, skin tone, hair, clothing, background and illumination as far as the model allows.
Close both eyes naturally and completely. Preserve identity, face shape, skin tone, hair, clothing, background and illumination as far as the model allows.

scope: Day9 opt-in20 only; historical106 and default generator profiles unchanged
lip_semantics: target landmark vertical mouth opening / horizontal mouth width, not probability
pose_semantics: absolute motion-model yaw in degrees; positive=image left, negative=image right; achieved pose not guaranteed
pose_range_note: Official UI uses relative yaw within +/-25. Absolute35/45 are explicitly experimental matrix extrapolations, not author-validated limits.
